questions.prompt: How do you scale out an application named 'web' by adding 3 units on a machine cloud?
questions.explanation: On machine-based clouds, 'juju add-unit <app> -n <N>' provisions and adds N units to the application.

questions.prompt: Which command removes a specific unit 'web/2' gracefully?
questions.explanation: 'juju remove-unit <unit-name>' invokes charm stop/relation departed hooks and terminates the unit instance.

questions.prompt: How can you provision a standalone machine in the active model before deploying any workload to it?
questions.explanation: 'juju add-machine' creates an empty machine managed by Juju.

questions.prompt: What placement directive flag is used to deploy a charm unit directly onto an existing machine ID 4?
questions.explanation: The '--to <machine-id>' flag specifies placement of newly deployed charms onto specific machines or containers.

questions.prompt: How do you place a unit into an isolated LXD container on machine 2?
questions.explanation: Juju supports nested container placement using container type prefixes like '--to lxd:2'.

questions.prompt: Which command connects you via SSH directly to unit 'db/0' using Juju keys?
questions.explanation: 'juju ssh <unit>' manages SSH keys and resolves connection endpoints seamlessly.

questions.prompt: Which command executes a shell command on multiple machines or units simultaneously across a model?
questions.explanation: 'juju exec' allows executing arbitrary shell commands across targeted units or machines.

questions.prompt: Which command displays all storage instances and attachments across the active model?
questions.explanation: 'juju storage' outputs all active storage volumes, file systems, and unit attachments.

questions.prompt: How do you request 20GB of storage for a charm's declared storage tag 'data' at deploy time?
questions.explanation: The '--storage <tag>=<size>' argument attaches requested storage capacity to the deployed charm unit.

questions.prompt: Which command lists available storage provider pools in the current model or cloud?
questions.explanation: 'juju storage-pools' displays the configured storage backends (e.g. lxd, ebs, ceph).
